records.canonicalIdentity: Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Jedi Consular|Adept Negotiator
records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can weaken the resolve of one enemy with your words. The target must have an Intelligence of 3 or higher and must be able to see, hear, and understand you. Make a Persuasion check; if the result equals or exceeds the target's Will Defense, it moves -1 step along the condition track. The target gets a +5 bonus to its Will Defense if it is higher level than you. If the target reaches the end of the track, it does not fall unconscious; instead, it cannot attack you or your allies for the remainder of the encounter unless you or one of your allies attacks it or one of its allies first. This is a mind-affecting effect.
